account: Most of today's town business has seemed quiet. The secretary and residents I asked reported no concerns or actionable news, and no account figures or payments have been brought for my scheduled accounts review. There are a few connected-looking activities, but I do not yet know their purpose. The builder was looking for the innkeeper and freight operator this morning; my neighbour said it was business and knew of nothing amiss. I later saw the innkeeper near town hall, but did not manage to speak with him. A lantern appeared in the great hall around 10:36, though I did not see who placed it or why. Now the secretary reports that the innkeeper wants a thirty-minute meeting tomorrow at eighteen in the great hall, with his committee, concerning civic hospitality and community gatherings. He specifically requested that the secretary escort me. I have approved the meeting and asked who belongs to the committee and whether there is an agenda; I have not yet received those answers or confirmation that the booking has been entered. These arrangements may be ordinary preparations for a community gathering, possibly involving the builder and freight operator, but that connection is only a suspicion. I have no evidence of wrongdoing or a hidden purpose. My tea with the neighbour at the dockside cottage at fifteen today remains an opportunity to hear more local news.
